Pollard, the director of "Tonight At Twelve," born in 1879. This error was due to an incorrect comparative analysis of the gathered birth dates. Despite correctly retrieving the birth years for both directors (1879 for Harry A. Pollard and 1964 for Eric Mendelsohn), the Planner failed to correctly identify that Harry A. Pollard, born in 1879, is significantly older than Eric Mendelsohn by 85 years. This mistake aligns with the "misinterpretation of comparative logic" pattern, as the error occurred in synthesizing the correctly obtained data and forming the final conclusion.
